events.subtitle: First live-album release performance at the room where it was recorded
events.category: ALFIE recording-room return / first live-album release performance
events.factual_description: Sora Ichikawa leads the Concept Band at Jazz House ALFIE in Roppongi on September 12, 2026 at 7:15 PM, with Ichikawa on piano, 高橋将 on bass and 塚田陽太 on drums. Disk Union's company press release identifies the performance as the release live for Ichikawa's first live album, Sora Ichikawa Concept Band, recorded at ALFIE. The album is described as a continuous live work without MC or breaks, giving the return to the recording room a direct performance context.

enrichment.note: ALFIE's official September 2026 schedule verifies the September 12 CD-release performance and a JPY 5,500 tax-inclusive music charge. The venue additionally requires at least two food/drink items; their cost is not included or estimated. Reservations are by telephone, not through the website or email, so no exact online ticket destination is stored. Apple Music remains unverified; no destination is inferred.

provenance.note: Repository searches for Sora Ichikawa, 市川空 and the September 12 ALFIE date found no matching RADAR candidate before publication. Stage 1 admission rests on the Concept Band returning to ALFIE, the exact room where its first live album was recorded, which also connects directly to the project's ALFIE listening thread. Stage 2 assigns A: the context is specific and worth knowing, but no scarcity or singular one-off claim is documented.

en.why_it_matters: The room is part of the record's identity: Ichikawa's first live album was captured at ALFIE as one continuous performance, and the same piano-bass-drums concept returns there for the release show. It is more than another young-trio date; it folds a new Japanese-jazz voice directly into the ALFIE thread that started RADAR.
en.trip_verdict: If September 12 falls inside a Tokyo stay, catch it if the night is open and let ALFIE anchor the evening. The return to the recording room gives it extra weight without displacing a rarer date.

es.why_it_matters: La sala forma parte de la identidad del disco: el primer álbum en vivo de Ichikawa se grabó en ALFIE como una sola secuencia continua, y el mismo concepto de piano, bajo y batería vuelve ahí para el concierto de lanzamiento. No es sólo otra fecha de un trío joven; mete una voz nueva del jazz japonés directamente en el hilo del lugar donde nació RADAR.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 12 de septiembre cae dentro de una estancia en Tokio, la agarraría si la noche está libre y dejaría que ALFIE la ancle. El regreso al lugar de la grabación le da un peso especial, sin necesidad de desplazar una fecha más rara.

events.factual_description: ArtDontSleep's official Le Jazz Est Mort tour page lists Cortex at Howard Theatre in Washington, DC on Tuesday, October 6, 2026 as part of the band's North American Tour 2026. AXS lists the performance at 8:00 PM. ArtDontSleep identifies Cortex as the French psychedelic jazz-funk group founded and led by pianist, composer and vocalist Alain Mion, and connects the 1975 album Troupeau Bleu to a broad hip-hop sampling history. The 2026 page describes a multi-city North American tour; the same presenter also documents a 2024 North American Cortex run.

enrichment.note: Date, Washington/Howard Theatre stop, 8:00 PM start, Alain Mion's founder-leader role and the Le Jazz Est Mort 2026 tour context were verified from ArtDontSleep and AXS. The AXS page currently surfaces Marketplace resale inventory, so no resale price is copied and no official face-value price is inferred. Supporting 2026 personnel are not inferred from the documented 2024 lineup.

provenance.note: Repository search for Cortex returned no matching RADAR candidate before publication. Stage 1 admission rests on the founder-led band's specific jazz-funk vocabulary, groove and cross-genre cultural afterlife through hip-hop sampling, plus a local Washington performance. Stage 2 assigns A+: this is actively worth making room for locally, but the documented multi-city 2026 tour and prior 2024 North American tour do not support S-tier scarcity.

en.why_it_matters: Cortex sits exactly where groove, instrumental identity and cultural afterlife meet. Alain Mion is still leading the project more than fifty years after Troupeau Bleu, and those French jazz-funk lines now carry a second history through the hip-hop records that sampled them. Hearing that continuum live in Washington is a concrete cross-genre event, not nostalgia.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for the Howard Theatre date if October 6 is open. It is local, the musical thread is unusually on-point, and there is no need to manufacture travel scarcity around a tour with multiple North American stops.

es.why_it_matters: Cortex cae justo donde se cruzan groove, identidad instrumental y una segunda vida cultural. Alain Mion sigue al frente del proyecto más de cincuenta años después de Troupeau Bleu, y esas líneas de jazz-funk francés ya cargan otra historia a través de los discos de hip-hop que las samplearon. Escuchar ese continuo en Washington es un cruce de lenguajes concreto, no nostalgia.
es.trip_verdict: Si el 6 de octubre está libre, sí le haría espacio activamente a la fecha del Howard Theatre. Es local y el hilo musical embona de lleno; no hace falta inventarle escasez de viaje a una gira con varias paradas norteamericanas.
